predictions.risk_pattern: Unchecked modular inverse computation in elliptic curve arithmetic - if xdiff ≡ 0 mod p (points have same x-coordinate), the inverse doesn't exist, leading to undefined behavior in subsequent calculations
enclosing_conditions: if(pointEqual(pointP, pointQ)) handles equal points case by calling pointDouble instead
predictions.context_summary: Elliptic curve point addition function that computes the sum of two distinct points; the unchecked inverse occurs when calculating the slope (lambda) for the addition formula
unresolved_facts: Whether the elliptic curve parameters ensure xdiff is never 0 mod p for distinct points
Whether callers validate point inputs to prevent degenerate cases
